title: Economy Issues in production.ts
summary: Fixed all 8 economy issues in production.ts per design docs

issues.implementation: Updated calculateGrossProduction() to apply racialProductionModifier to factory output (line ~175)

issues.description: Difficulty Modifiers apply to net production after cleanup costs
issues.implementation: Moved difficulty modifier application from gross production to calculateNetProduction() after cleanup is subtracted (line ~215)

issues.description: Ship_Maintenance = Ship_Cost × 0.02, with racial/tech modifiers, min 1 BC
issues.implementation: Added calculateShipMaintenance() and calculateFleetMaintenance() functions with SHIP_MAINTENANCE_RATE=0.02 constant

issues.description: Bankruptcy: scuttle ships at 10% emergency scrap rate until treasury positive
issues.implementation: Added handleBankruptcy() function with EMERGENCY_SCRAP_RATE=0.10 constant

issues.description: Mice (Meklars) receive +2 to effective Robotic Controls level
issues.implementation: Added racialRCBonus field to ProductionContext and getEffectiveRCLevel() helper function

issues.description: At least one slider must remain unlocked
issues.implementation: Added canLockSlider() and lockSlider() functions with validation, added CANNOT_LOCK_LAST_SLIDER error type
Already exists in ProductionContext, verified correct usage in calculateGrossProduction()
Already exists on Planet type and used in allocateSliders() (line ~277)

new_functions: calculateFleetMaintenance(shipDesigns: Array<{cost, count}>, ctx: ProductionContext): number
canLockSlider(current: SliderState, keyToLock: keyof SliderState): boolean
lockSlider(current: SliderState, keyToLock: keyof SliderState): RebalanceResult

test_results.typecheck_notes: Production.ts compiles cleanly. Pre-existing errors in diplomacy.ts and treaties.ts are unrelated to these changes.

design_compliance.quote: These modifiers apply to the final net production after cleanup costs
Ship_Maintenance = Ship_Cost × Maintenance_Rate; Maintenance_Rate = 0.02 (2% of construction cost per turn); Minimum Maintenance: 1 BC per ship
Meklars (Mice) Special Ability: Mice receive +2 to their effective Robotic Controls level
At least one slider must remain unlocked (otherwise re-balancing is impossible)
